name: concord
description: Concord keeps people in control of AI coding agents: plans you approve, scoped implementation by low-cost models, tests first, independent review and a ledger of every verdict.

plugins.name: concord
plugins.description: Keep control of AI coding agents. Each task becomes a short plan that a verifier challenges and you approve; low-cost models implement it within a fixed file scope that every run's report checks, against tests that must fail first; an independent reviewer checks each change at its risk level and a cheap delta review checks each fix; every verdict is recorded with its cause. You commit; Concord never does. Needs the dispatcher from the repository's install.sh. Actively developed: new versions ship through this marketplace.
